title: Bitpanda targets banks with Vision Chain tokenization platform
summary: The Vienna-based crypto broker announced its Ethereum layer-2, aimed at helping European banks and fintechs issue tokenized assets under MiCA and MiFID II.

title: Marshall Islands basic income effort gains crypto-connected backers
summary: Despite an IMF warning regarding the potential risks, the Marshall Islands is proceeding with a partnership which could expand its digital sovereign bond to institutional markets.

title: UK review recommends crypto donation pause over foreign interference risk
summary: A UK review led by Philip Rycroft recommended a temporary moratorium on crypto political donations until stronger safeguards and statutory guidance are in place.

title: STS Digital launches structured crypto platform with Kraken as first partner
summary: STS Digital said the platform offers institutional clients access to options-based strategies through predefined crypto investment products.

title: Bitcoin rebounds during Iran war, but safe haven role unproven
summary: Bitcoin is beating gold during the Iran war, but its dependence on liquidity cycles keeps the safe haven narrative in question.

title: Bitcoin bounces from 50-day trend line with $72K BTC price now key focus
summary: Bitcoin traders agreed that BTC price action needed to retake $72,000 to open up the odds of further upside as gold and US stocks gained.

title: Governments need CBDCs to improve financial inclusion among citizens
summary: CBDCs bridge the 1.3 billion unbanked cash-digital divide. Governments must actively promote them as trusted, low-cost gateways to formal financial inclusion.

title: ECB targets summer for digital euro standards: Cipollone
summary: The ECB’s Piero Cipollone said the central bank wants key technical standards for a possible digital euro locked in by this summer so banks and merchants can prepare for the rollout.

title: Bitcoin retakes $71K as US sends Iran 15-point ceasefire plan
summary: Bitcoin bounced back above $71,000 after US President Donald Trump’s administration sent a proposal to Iran aimed at ending the war.

title: Bhutan offloads another $37M in Bitcoin as sovereign wallet shrinks
summary: Bhutan moved 519 Bitcoin from its state-linked wallet, extending a March drawdown that has cut its sovereign stash far below 2024 levels.
